title: JEMULICE Self-Inflating Camping Mat — 12 cm, with Foot Pump & Pillow
short_description: A self-inflating camping mat, 200 x 68 x 12 cm, with integrated foot pump and pillow. Ultralight, waterproof and foldable — for outdoors, hiking and camping.
long_description: The JEMULICE camping mat is a self-inflating sleeping pad 12 cm thick, measuring 200 x 68 x 12 cm. An integrated foot pump fills it quickly, and the built-in pillow adds comfort. Made of 40D nylon with a TPU coating, it is waterproof and tear-resistant and keeps your body comfortably off the cold ground. Ultralight and foldable, it packs down well; two mats can be joined by buttons into a double mat. Ideal for camping, tents, hiking and trekking.
buying_angle: Practical for campers and hikers who want a thick, self-inflating mat with pump and pillow for restful sleep in the tent.
